experiment: Whole-task composition on one fresh source: BASE vs composed surviving deletions (browser TypeSafe + scripted; native scripted), with build qualification (Phase 0) and recertification
hypothesis: On one source and binary, composing the surviving verified deletions cuts whole-task verified time T. S = median T_BASE / median T_COMP has a 95% CI lower bound above 1 for each browser class (fill->submit, toggle->confirm, modal->act) and each native GTK3 task (checkbox, text entry), with identical verified outcomes and zero E4 violations.

U.use: Phase 0 (b)/(c) positive control only, never timing

environment: one Linux host; bin/hostless v2 (Landlock + env scrub) for every code-executing command; native additionally nested in bin/hostless-strict (bwrap mask of host socket dirs), as N-01R; private Xvfb session cua-x11-session.sh (AT-SPI bus for native); Driver telemetry off (CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0, DO_NOT_TRACK=1); TMPDIR under the lane tmp root; 1-minute loadavg recorded per trial

phase0_gate.rule: Any failure means STOP: the packet reports BLOCKED or REVISE with a diagnosis and runs no measured trial.
phase0_gate.a_unit: R tree: cargo test -p cua-driver-core --lib browser:: (>= 187 passed, 0 failed, FIX-01 tests included) and phase_trace; jev-use python unittest discover (incl. test_runner_refusal.py, test_guarded_runner.py) and npm test (incl. run_refusal.test.ts) rc 0
phase0_gate.b_fix01_c1: FIX-01 harness phase c1 (page re-render between bind and dispatch) on R n=20: first Submit click refused browser_ref_stale 20/20, 0 old-node page events, rebind + verify 20/20 (journal applied 1 with the token). U positive control: first click accepted >= 5/5 (n=5).
phase0_gate.c_b02_nw2: B-02 N-W2 (run_b02.control_one, kind nw2: same-document node replacement between snapshot and action) on R, toggle and modal n=20 each: stale action refused 20/20 per class and 0 detached-handler server effects (journal); U control: stale action fires the server effect >= 5/5 per class (n=5).
phase0_gate.d_default_off: R with no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* and no CUA_DRIVER_PHASE_TRACE_FILE vs Cn: tools/list reply bytes identical (raw stdio, 3 reads each); 5 runs per class/task (fill, toggle, modal: BASE arm; checkbox, text: native BASE) give identical receipt shapes (per mutation: tool, route, effect, sorted result keys; native: route/effect/status/sorted keys) and verified outcomes; no phase-trace file appears (browser: no new trace-like file in the session HOME/TMPDIR; native: the pre-created per-trial file stays empty).
phase0_gate.e_r2_07b: on R, n >= 5 each: (1) verified training execution (guarded scripted run, oracle-verified) -> compile (authority check clean) -> (2) clean-reset admission replay (fresh fixture state, Driver, browser; compiled replay, no fallback) verified by the oracle, 5/5; (3) fresh binding before every compiled mutation (ref minted by the routine's latest observation, taken after the previous mutation) 100%; (4) N4a refuse + rebind = Phase 0 (b) R cells; (5) may-have-landed effects reconciled before any fallback = FIX-01 g5 rows applied_ack_lost / delayed_after_first_unchanged_read / withheld_unresolved, 5 each: 0 duplicates, 0 dispatches after unknown, applied/delayed verified_by_reconcile, withheld unknown.

arms.binary_rule: R in every arm; phase trace on (CUA_DRIVER_PHASE_TRACE_FILE per trial) in every arm

browser.BASE: product default (B-01 K0n shape): set_agent_cursor_enabled true + set_agent_cursor_motion {glide_duration_ms:0, dwell_after_click_ms:80} (Driver default glide), ordinary runner (run.py rules incl. FIX-01 Part B; no guarded completion, no compiled replay), completion poll 100 ms / 2.0 s deadline, library MCP output validation, no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* variable

COMP.completion_poll: 10 ms, same 2.0 s deadline [H_P not material]
COMP.mcp_output_validation: caller-compiled validators, compiled once at tools/list outside T [H_C KEEP]
COMP.compiled_replay: fill only [R2-07b KEEP]: the first COMP fill invocation per (layer, arm) runs the guarded step loop as training, then compile (timed) and a clean-reset admission replay (fresh Driver/browser, no fallback); admitted -> later invocations replay; refused (precondition failure, or a second browser_ref_stale) -> the guarded continuation takes the current state; not admitted -> later invocations run the guarded step loop. All counted.

browser.COMP_E: COMP + CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ENDPOINT_REPROOF=bound [B-02 H_E OWNER_DECISION]; scripted layer only
browser.COMP_K: COMP minus every OWNER_DECISION knob: feedback default ON (as BASE), focus settle default (100 ms); scripted layer only
browser.lifecycle: fresh Driver process, fresh isolated_new browser, fresh token per trial (B-02 run_b02/run_critpath lifecycle); setup (initialize, tools/list, validator compile, cursor calls, browser_prepare, bind, navigate) outside T

native.fixture: libs/cua-driver/tests/fixtures/apps/linux/gtk3/main.py (R tree), tasks checkbox toggle and text entry, private Xvfb + AT-SPI, background delivery, fresh Driver and fresh fixture per trial, scripted chooser (N-01R harness, unchanged, monkeypatched arms only)
native.S0: CUA_DRIVER_EXP_NATIVE_POST_ACTION_SLEEP_MS=0 [KEEP; DELETED scoped to GTK3 background delivery]

design.L_live: TypeSafe through jev-use choose_live_for_task, key forwarded by NAME only (CUA_SESSION_FORWARD_SECRETS=TYPESAFE_API_KEY); BASE vs COMP; 30 rounds; round r: classes in rotated order (r mod 3), each class one pair, order AB (BASE first) on even r, BA on odd r (15 AB + 15 BA per class)
design.L_scripted: scripted chooser (jev-use choose_mock_for_task, labelled 'scripted'); arms BASE, COMP, COMP_K, COMP_E; 32 rounds; round r: classes rotated, each class runs the 4 arms in Williams row (r mod 4) of the 4x4 Williams square
design.native: 24 rounds; round r: task order alternates by round; each task runs BASE, S0, X in row (r mod 6) of the 3-treatment Williams design (3x3 square + mirror = 6 sequences)

controls_excluded_from_T.N4a: inside L-scripted COMP, n=5 per class: an independent CDP client replaces the next mutation's target node (same document) between bind and dispatch (fill: inside the compiled replay before Submit; toggle/modal: before action 2); must refuse (browser_ref_stale) and rebind (one fresh observation) -> verified
controls_excluded_from_T.OOD: n=5: the scripted COMP fill routine applied to the toggle (k even) / modal (k odd) page: must fail its precondition and fall back to the guarded continuation (current state, chooser) -> verified
controls_excluded_from_T.N-W2: n=5 (classes rotate fill/toggle/modal): run_b02 control_one kind nw2 with the COMP admission knob; stale action refused, 0 detached-handler effects, fresh re-derivation verified
controls_excluded_from_T.fallback: when compiled replay is refused, the guarded continuation runs and is counted in the COMP denominators
controls_excluded_from_T.native_focus_steal: N-01R decoy (xprobe.Decoy) steals focus ~100 ms after the app state changes (DoAction landed), n=5 per arm per task (BASE, S0, X): the guard must restore focus 5/5 per arm

design.lock: every measured block runs under bin/quiet-timed (EXCLUSIVE quiet-lane lock, ledger receipt) AND holds flock on the cargo-build lock for the chunk; chunks <= 40 min; released between chunks; each background run < 2 h
design.order_of_work: Phase 0 (a)-(e) -> L-scripted chunks -> controls -> L-live chunks -> native main -> native focus-steal; every trial and failure kept

forced_paths.browser: clicks: dom_event route through the Driver CDP engine (candidate input_route dom_event; receipt route 'dom'; trace click.cdp_send inside the call); typing: browser_type (receipt route recorded per action, must be identical across arms). A row whose action route differs from its arm's forced path is refused (invalid, kept in the denominator).
forced_paths.native: AT-SPI DoAction (click, background delivery) and set_value; receipt route 'accessibility' and the R2-04 click/set_value mark sequence present in order; knob marks exactly as the arm sets them; cursor motion as the arm sets it
forced_paths.arm_configuration_checks_browser: feedback: BASE/COMP_K arrival waits present and arrived with glide_duration_ms 0, COMP/COMP_E none; settle (fill): BASE/COMP_K 100 ms, COMP/COMP_E 0 ms; poll sleeps equal the arm's poll; V: every admitted tools/call inside T shows mcp.inner_validation_skipped (COMP arms) / none (BASE); E: COMP_E ep.bound_hit per reval.native_window inside T, others no ep.bound_* mark; compiled validators > 0 in COMP arms; decision routes: BASE provider only; COMP fill compiled / compiled+fallback / training (provider, guarded-completion) / guarded after a failed admission

oracle: independent, target-owned, polled every 2 ms by a harness thread: browser = the jev-use fixture server state (fill: submitted == token; toggle: checked true; modal: opened and modal true) with its CLOCK_MONOTONIC journal; native = the GTK3 task state file (CUA_GTK3_TASK_STATE, fresh per trial)

metrics.T0: send of the first observation request (browser: label snapshot1; native: get_window_state send)
metrics.T_oracle_gating: T0 -> first 2 ms oracle sample, taken at or after the return of the task's last accepted mutation, that shows the expected final state (N-01R rule, applied to both surfaces)
metrics.T_land: T0 -> first oracle sample showing the expected final state (regardless of returns)
metrics.T_runner: browser: T0 -> the runner's first oracle-confirmed read (B-01 definition); native: T0 -> return of the last action (the scripted native runner has no verification read)
metrics.decomposition: browser: B-01 b01_analysis.decompose (telescoping over T_runner) with the B-02 taxonomy extension (analyze_browser.classify_mark), reported as provider decision(s), observation, resolution, endpoint revalidation (reval_endpoint), revalidation other, MCP admission (pre_admission_validate + pre_inner_validate), MCP transport in/out (transport + driver_post_dispatch + pre_other), client validation, visualization/glide, input prep, focus settle (settles), dispatch (+ dispatch_post), target effect (target_effect_lag), verification reads, sleeps/polls, runner, unattributed; native: N-01R contiguous boundaries from the merged trace (phase/session keys, CLOCK_MONOTONIC): observation transport, observation, runner/lookup, resolution, reveal, dispatch (AT-SPI DoAction / set_value write), post-action sleep, guard settle, result, action transport, effect lag, verification read

statistics.S: per class/task and arm pair: S = median T_BASE / median T_arm over rounds where both trials are valid; seeded paired bootstrap over rounds (seed 20261002, 10000 resamples, percentile 95% CI)
statistics.reported: S_COMP (live and scripted), S_COMP_K and S_COMP_E (scripted), S_S0 and S_X (native)
statistics.fill: S_all (gating): COMP rows include the training invocation with its charged cost T_charged = T_oracle(training) + compile_ms + T_oracle(admission replay); S_amortized = sum T_BASE / sum T_COMP_charged over paired rounds (ratio of means, same bootstrap); S_warm = median ratio over rounds excluding the training round
statistics.secondary_analysis: subset with 1-minute loadavg < 2 at trial start (both trials of a pair)

gates.validity: >= 95% verified (oracle exact match, exactly one completion mutation, runner outcome verified) per arm per class/task, over all trials including errors
gates.E4: 0 stale-ref dispatches (accepted mutation not bound by the latest observation after the previous mutation, or accepted dispatch onto a replaced node, or a detached-handler server effect), 0 duplicate mutations (completion mutations > 1), 0 unverified successes (runner verified, oracle not), refusals classified as refused (no effect=refused result returned as success), 0 blind replays (no re-dispatch of an accepted candidate; redispatch_blocked ends unknown)
gates.S: gating S per class/task: browser = L-live S_COMP (fill: S_all) AND L-scripted S_COMP (fill: S_all) CI lower bounds > 1; native = S_X CI lower bound > 1 per task. S_COMP_K, S_COMP_E, S_S0, fill S_amortized/S_warm are reported, not gating.
gates.E2: untested share per task on COMP (sum of mean component time whose verdict is UNTESTED, over mean T_runner); target < 5%

disposition.KEEP: every class/task has gating S CI lower bound > 1 and validity and E4 gates hold
disposition.REVISE: only some do (name them; the revised claim is the measured one)
disposition.KILL: none do, or any E4 gate fails

browser.provider_decision: fill: second decision DELETED (guarded completion, R2-03 KEEP), remaining decision DELETED on warm invocations (compiled replay, R2-07b KEEP; kept in training/fallback rows); toggle/modal: UNTESTED (plausibly deletable by a compiled routine; not qualified for these classes at this source; guarded completion binds 0/160)
browser.observation: IRREDUCIBLE (one fresh semantic snapshot per mutation, #73)
browser.mcp_admission: DELETED fill/toggle (H_V); modal NOT_MATERIAL -> counted IRREDUCIBLE-scale residual; residual after the cache UNTESTED
browser.client_validation: DELETED (H_C KEEP; residual compiled-validator time UNTESTED)
browser.visualization: OWNER_DECISION (feedback; residual platform-gate bookkeeping in COMP)

e2_verdicts_preregistered.T_irreducible: sum of the mean components whose verdict is IRREDUCIBLE on the COMP arm (native: X); floor ratio = mean T_runner(COMP) / T_irreducible (also reported with median T_oracle)

shakedown_before_prereg.note: lshake2: 1 fill COMP training decision + 2 toggle BASE + 2 modal BASE; an earlier lshake1 ran the same plan with the scripted chooser by a harness bug (0 attempts)

provider_budget.ledger: raw/provider-ledger.jsonl, one line per HTTP attempt (attempt, reached, latency, status, class, arm, layer, trial); no headers, bodies, request ids or credentials
provider_budget.stop_rule: before each live trial the harness requires reached + 3 <= 330 and attempts + 3 <= 363 (lane totals incl. the shakedown); otherwise the remaining pairs are NOT_RUN

shakedowns_before_prereg: scripted browser shake1 (crashed after a 180 s trial timeout, harness fixed), shake2, shake3; native nshake1, nshake2 (decoy); live lshake1 (scripted by bug), lshake2 (5 reached). All under the SHARED quiet-lane lock with receipts; none is measured or analysed.

references_not_gates.PreAct: 8.5-13x warm replay (different benchmark: warm replay of recorded plans, not whole-task verified time on this fixture)
references_not_gates.SkillDroid: ~2.4x pure replay only (different benchmark and platform)

claim_boundary: one Linux host, X11 Xvfb, the jev-use and GTK3 fixtures; TypeSafe for the browser live layer, scripted chooser elsewhere; binary R built from 989cc76ce + the listed commits; OWNER_DECISION components labelled; no default change claimed; never compared with B-01, B-02 or N-01R absolute numbers (different source, binary and environment)
denominators: every trial is kept; errors and forced-path failures stay in the validity denominators; a block whose session fails to start is kept, counted and re-run under a new label
